title: Formulary Benefit External Review Priority: Reserve for Failed Specialty Deliveries
content:
**Reserve clause.** When a member asks for an independent external review of a denied exception under the Formulary Benefit, a delivery-failure reserve is taken off the days of the drug the member has left. The member's Specialty Pharmacy Program records of replacement shipments of the drug, and the reason recorded for each, are read within the review reship lookback of **6** months. A replacement is within the lookback when its ship date lies fewer whole months than 6 before the handling date.

| Replacement shipments of the drug within the lookback | Reserve taken off the days left |
|---|---|
| at least one because of a temperature excursion | **2** days |
| none for a temperature excursion, at least one because of a missed delivery | **1** day |
| none | nothing |

The reserve is taken off the days left before they are compared with the review's wait.

*Hypothetical.* With 4 days of the drug left and a temperature-excursion reshipment three months ago, the days left become 2. If the only reshipment in the lookback was for a missed delivery, they become 3. A temperature-excursion reshipment 6 whole months ago is outside the lookback and takes nothing off.
